editorial.blurb: La Lunita is a gorgeous Mexican seafood destination where thoughtful service, creative cocktails, and dishes with complex, subtle heat make every visit feel like a night out with good friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for off-menu cocktail recommendations—one reviewer raved about a phenomenal drink that wasn't on the menu, and the bartenders excel at custom mezcal and tequila creations. Come for Vino and Vinyl wine nights if you can.
